title: Gideon and the Garden
author: Noor Iversen
blurb: Casper Dunmore, an exiled storm-caller, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
